raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Refs #45563. A failed NIXL write can leave an empty or truncated cache file. The current lookup treats any existing file as a hit, and NIXL 1.4.0 can report a short read as successful. This lets a restore publish incomplete KV or sidecar data. The issue reports incorrect DSA outputs after restoring empty indexer files.

Lookup checks alone are insufficient: hybrid restores using `assume_stored` can skip lookup. Validate the requested byte count at the shared read entrypoint before starting a transfer.

## Modifications

- Treat empty FILE objects as lookup misses.
- Reject FILE reads when any file is missing or smaller than its corresponding host buffer. Reuse the existing transfer sizes, including unequal Mamba component sizes; allow larger files for alignment padding. A rejected transfer leaves its destination unchanged and uses the existing failure propagation.
- Extend the existing POSIX tests with real truncated files for KV copy/zero-copy, indexer copy, and Mamba zero-copy paths. Cover empty, one-byte-short, complete, and padded files.

The production change adds 19 lines, with no new configuration or cached metadata. OBJ and write paths retain their existing behavior. This addresses the unsafe restore part of #45563; write alignment and batch chunking are separate work tracked by #35231, #42491, #36524, and #37690. It does not detect same-size corruption or make concurrent writes atomic.

## Accuracy Tests

Local Ubuntu WSL, Python 3.12.3, torch 2.14.0+cpu, NIXL/nixl-cu13 1.4.0. Tests use the normal test-file entrypoint and genuine `CustomTestCase`, real NIXL/POSIX, and actual files, with the existing host-pool fixtures. No external module substitutions.

```bash
python test/registered/unit/mem_cache/test_hicache_nixl_storage.py -v
```

- Original production source at `74c08f3dc5d98dddf052ba03122fc084a31a0269` plus the new tests: both regression methods fail, with 8 failing subcases and no errors.
- Patched source: 26 tests run, 25 passed and 1 skipped (optional MinIO test unavailable).
- All applicable pre-commit hooks pass for both changed files, including registered-test validation.

This verifies storage behavior. No end-to-end GLM/EAGLE accuracy run or multi-GPU test was performed. Implementation, local validation, and connected-call-chain review were AI-assisted.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Each FILE read adds one batched metadata query. Measured real `batch_get_v1` on the same cache, files, and CPU tensors, switching only the original/patched transfer method. POSIX, warm Linux filesystem cache, O_DIRECT disabled, two files per logical page. Each of three process runs used 8 warmups and 120 measured reads per variant, with alternating order.

| Page size | Pages per batch | Median before / after (microseconds) | Median change across runs |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 8 KiB | 1 | 394.5 / 404.2 | +2.5% to +4.5% |
| 8 KiB | 32 | 647.6 / 702.1 | +7.8% to +15.8% |
| 8 KiB | 128 | 1821.8 / 2113.1 | +15.2% to +16.0% |
| 256 KiB | 1 | 419.1 / 435.5 | -5.4% to +4.8% |
| 256 KiB | 32 | 1192.4 / 1295.8 | +7.5% to +9.6% |
| 256 KiB | 128 | 5703.4 / 6040.4 | +3.4% to +5.9% |

Latency columns are the medians of the three per-process medians. All data restoration checks passed. The 128-page cases add roughly 0.21–0.34 ms. Single-page differences approach measurement noise. These are local CPU/POSIX microbenchmarks, not serving throughput measurements; remote filesystem metadata queries may cost more. GDS/3FS, cold-cache I/O, and end-to-end inference performance were not measured.

## Checklist

- [x] Format code with the repository pre-commit hooks for changed files.
- [x] Add regression tests to the existing registered test module.
- [ ] Update documentation: no user-facing configuration or API change.
- [x] Provide storage correctness results and local read microbenchmarks; full model accuracy and serving speed remain untested.
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style guidance.

+        if direction == "READ" and self.backend_selector.mem_type == "FILE":
+            # NIXL <= 1.4 can report short reads as successful. Check here,
+            # including restores that bypass batch_exists via assume_stored.
+            query_res = self.agent.query_memory(
+                [(0, 0, 0, key) for key in keys],
+                self.backend_selector.backend_name,
+                mem_type="FILE",
+            )
+            if len(query_res) != len(host_buffers) or any(
+                res is None or int(res.get("size", 0)) < size
+                for res, (_, size) in zip(query_res, host_buffers)
+            ):
+                return False
+
         host_descs = self.agent.get_xfer_descs(
             [(addr, size, 0) for (addr, size) in host_buffers], "DRAM"
         )

+    def test_batch_exists_rejects_incomplete_files(self):
+        """Empty files miss lookup; truncated reads cannot publish partial KV."""
+        self.addCleanup(self.hicache.close)
+        keys = ["complete", "incomplete", "later"]
+        for zero_copy in (False, True):
+            with self.subTest(zero_copy=zero_copy):
+                host = MockMemPoolHost(is_zero_copy_mode=zero_copy)
+                self.hicache.register_mem_pool_host(host)
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    self.hicache.batch_set_v1(keys, torch.arange(6)), [True] * 3
+                )
+                storage_key = (
+                    self.hicache._get_key_list_from_meta(keys)[3]
+                    if zero_copy
+                    else self.hicache._get_suffixed_key(keys[1])
+                )
+                path = self.hicache.file_manager.get_file_path(storage_key)
+                full_size = os.path.getsize(path)
+                self.assertEqual(self.hicache.batch_exists(keys), 3)
+                for size in (0, full_size - 1, full_size, full_size + 4096):
+                    with self.subTest(size=size):
+                        os.truncate(path, size)
+                        self.assertEqual(
+                            self.hicache.batch_exists(keys),
+                            1 if size == 0 else 3,
+                        )
+                        host.kv_buffer.fill_(9)
+                        self.assertEqual(
+                            self.hicache.batch_get_v1(keys, torch.arange(6)),
+                            [size >= full_size] * 3,
+                        )
+                        if size < full_size:
+                            self.assertTrue(torch.all(host.kv_buffer == 9))
+
+    def test_batch_exists_v2_rejects_incomplete_sidecars(self):
+        """Complete KV cannot make a truncated indexer or Mamba state a hit."""
+        self.addCleanup(self.hicache.close)
+        keys = ["sidecar-first", "sidecar-second", "sidecar-third"]
+        self.hicache.register_mem_pool_host(MockMemPoolHost(False))
+        self.assertEqual(self.hicache.batch_set_v1(keys, torch.arange(6)), [True] * 3)
+        for name, zero_copy in ((PoolName.INDEXER, False), (PoolName.MAMBA, True)):
+            with self.subTest(pool=name):
+                host = MockHybridPool(expose_zero_copy=zero_copy)
+                if zero_copy:
+                    # The temporal and convolution components need different sizes.
+                    host.conv_buffer = [torch.zeros((4, 16), dtype=torch.uint8)]
+                self.hicache.register_mem_host_pool_v2(host, name)
+                transfer = PoolTransfer(
+                    name=name, keys=keys, host_indices=torch.arange(3)
+                )
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    self.hicache.batch_set_v2([transfer]), {name: [True] * 3}
+                )
+                result = self.hicache.batch_exists_v2(keys, [transfer])
+                self.assertEqual(result.kv_hit_pages, 3)
+                multiplier = 2 if zero_copy else 1
+                storage_key = self.hicache._get_hybrid_component_keys(
+                    keys, name, multiplier
+                )[2 * multiplier - 1]
+                path = self.hicache.file_manager.get_file_path(storage_key)
+                full_size = os.path.getsize(path)
+                for size in (0, full_size - 1, full_size):
+                    with self.subTest(size=size):
+                        os.truncate(path, size)
+                        result = self.hicache.batch_exists_v2(keys, [transfer])
+                        self.assertEqual(result.kv_hit_pages, 1 if size == 0 else 3)
+                        self.assertEqual(result.extra_pool_hit_pages[PoolName.KV], 3)
+                        host.temporal_buffer.fill_(9)
+                        host.conv_buffer[0].fill_(9)
+                        self.assertEqual(
+                            self.hicache.batch_get_v2([transfer]),
+                            {name: [size >= full_size] * 3},
+                        )
+                        if size < full_size:
+                            self.assertTrue(torch.all(host.temporal_buffer == 9))
+                            self.assertTrue(torch.all(host.conv_buffer[0] == 9))
+
     def test_register_mem_host_pool_v2_uses_zero_copy_when_supported(self):
         pool = MockHybridPool(expose_zero_copy=True)
         self.hicache.register_mem_host_pool_v2(pool, PoolName.MAMBA)
